CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   C. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

7. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
